content.v: EA被沙特一家基金收购，公司迎来重大转折。当时外界就担忧，这笔收购会带来项目取消、工作室关停。如今随着BioWare正式关闭，最坏的猜想已然成为现实。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261023/1792708844_737827_jpg_r.jpg
但这并不是EA第一次关闭收购而来的工作室。纵观其近40年的企业史，EA收购之后直接关停的工作室足有20家，这件事也凸显了其管理层在保留开发团队方面的糟糕表现。
随着BioWare落下帷幕，EA历史上被收购后关停的工作室总数来到20家。其中知名度最高的一批名单如下：
Maxis工作室：代表作《模拟人生》
西木头工作室：《命令与征服》《沙丘》
牛蛙工作室：《地下城守护者》
Visceral Games：《死亡空间》三部曲
BioWare：《龙腾世纪》《质量效应》

其余15家分别是：Origin Systems、Batteries Included、Kesmai、Danger Close Games、Black Box Games、EA Chicago、Hypnotix、Mythic Entertainment、Phenomic Game Development、EA Salt Lake、Pandemic、J2MSoft、Playfish、Chillingo、Industrial Toys。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261023/1792708844_284840_jpg_r.jpg
自创立至今，EA已关停上述20家收购得来的工作室。这一现象令人警惕——被EA收购，并不代表工作室就能安然生存。BioWare无疑是这20家中分量最重的。虽然《龙腾世纪：影障守护者》商业表现不及预期，但工作室本身依旧具备创作潜力。许多玩家认为，如果能给予他们机会完成《质量效应5》会是更好的结局。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: 曝暴雪为《星际争霸2》新项目组建大型开发团队
items.summary: 近日内容创作者StarcraftHistorian援引可靠消息源称，暴雪已为《星际争霸2》的一个新项目安排了规模较大的开发团队。消息称，团队可能先处理作弊问题，再推进更重要的内容，但暴雪尚未证实这一说法。该项目的潜在方向

content.v: 近日内容创作者StarcraftHistorian援引可靠消息源称，暴雪已为《 星际争霸2 》的一个新项目安排了规模较大的开发团队。消息称，团队可能先处理作弊问题，再推进更重要的内容，但暴雪尚未证实这一说法。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261023/1792708282_171764_jpg_r.jpg
该项目的潜在方向包括新资料片和重制版，爆料者认为后者的可能性更高。目前尚无项目名称、开发进度及发布时间，两种方向都仍是未经证实的推测。
《星际争霸2》当前面临天梯活跃度较低的问题，韩国服务器存在大量作弊者，欧洲服务器也受到影响。暴雪此前曾把开局工人数量从12名降至8名，希望放慢经济发展速度，但这一调整未获玩家认可，数月后被撤回。暴雪当时表示，今后还会推出新的平衡补丁。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261023/1792708986_801387.jpg
重制版猜测的另一条线索，是德国玩家收到的一则Windows 7支持即将终止通知，其中出现了“《星际争霸2》重制版”这一名称。不过，这也可能只是邮件笔误，原本所指或为已经存在的《星际争霸：重制版》，因此不足以证明《星际争霸2》重制版正在开发。

items.title: 我的 GOTY 售价 7 美元，有 253 条 Steam 评论
items.summary: Stuntboost is a racing game for FPS movement sickos.

content.v: Fast-paced. 3D Platformer. Parkour. First-Person. Racing.

Those are the tags affixed to the Steam page for Stuntboost , a game that I've had trouble summing up with a clean label when asked about it. Stuntboost is a skateboarding game that sometimes features a car, a platformer with a speedometer, an ode to those shrunken bedroom maps popularized by early FPS modders.
It's also, quite easily, my favorite game of 2026 so far.

Yet, Stuntboost could've easily slipped under my radar. It's been out for a month and hasn't made a big splash on Steam—it's rated "Very Positive" with 253 reviews. I only found it through a friend's recommendation, and even then, the art style didn't immediately suggest it was my thing.

Stunboost's toy fingerboards and cardboard circuits give the impression of a chill, Hot Wheels-adjacent racer your child could enjoy, but unless that child is accomplished with a mouse and keyboard, that ain't happening. This is the only skateboarding game with a warning that suggests you play with a mouse, and it's immediately obvious why.
Once you learn a few techniques, Stuntboost looks like this:
And this.
And this.

Despite its choice of vehicles, this thing's for FPS movement sickos—an exercise in precision camera control and first-person platforming. It's essentially a three button game (jump, crouch, grind) about gaining and maintaining speed. Many of its tracks are non-linear obstacle courses that ask you to find your own way across, and the devs actively encourage looking for shortcuts.

I've been obsessed (a word I'm not using lightly) with Stuntboost's 40+ levels for weeks now, replaying tracks and cutting seconds off my times to score the top medals. And once I have those medals, I get to work shaving hundredths of seconds to take the number one spot on my friend leaderboard. Oh man, this is a dangerous game for a friendly rivalry. I now live in fear of a Discord DM informing me that the PB I spent hours honing has been shattered.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/BjqjdjoD5LB67khBv36Bse-1920-80.jpg

But I honestly welcome the excuse to replay tracks, because Stuntboost's movement is fundamentally thrilling, and its maps are masterfully crafted with standard and absurd routing in mind. Its wide ramps, massive jumps, and daring speeds remind me a lot of Trackmania—my favorite racing series—but more specifically, a subset of "full speed" community tracks that never ask you to brake.

Stuntboost also nails a lot of little quality-of-life features that you rarely see in games with way larger budgets. Information about a track is revealed in stages: I can't see friends' times until I've beaten the track once, and global leaderboards are locked until I get the diamond medal. The ghost of my best time appears automatically, but I can also turn on the ghosts of my friends or anyone else on the leaderboard. I can even watch anyone's replay in full as long as I've discovered the same shortcuts they used—a smart touch (possibly inspired by Neon White ) that prevents spoilers and entices me to search for what I've missed.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/qwmkUSoNZhCSZUyjK4UWuR.jpg
"It's like Neon White"

BUT: I never finished Neon White because the levels got overwhelming. Juggling cards and shooting mandatory targets sometimes made levels feel strict and suffocating. Stuntboost is simpler, faster, and improvisational.

Watching replays is a big deal, too, because it's primarily how I picked up on community techniques that opened my third eye: varial kickflips, grind hopping, speed storage. Every sloped surface is an opportunity for just a bit more speed and every ramp-shaped object—be it a plate, playing card, or three-ring binder—is a springboard that could send me across the map. The variability of a single track can be staggering.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/XW5Wb4LJHEfZh9jtHjJwqe-1920-80.jpg

Later worlds (which visit other rooms of the same house) expand beyond the skateboard with car levels that revolve around drifting, free roam scooter levels with S-K-A-T-E collectibles, and a longboard that can't jump. Some of these are just a neat palate cleanser, but the car levels are particularly spectacular for how they force me to relearn how I turn and, eventually, hit sick drifts that're impossible on the skateboard.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/urWVNfAoSis6yuvJpbEgVZ.jpg
"It's like Trackmania"

BUT: Trackmania is a proper driving game, and Stuntboost is its own thing. Where Trackmania demands braking and cornering to improve track times, Stuntboost has no brake, lets you turn on a dime whenever, and encourages max speed at all costs. If I made a Trackmania, it'd be just like this.

Every level has a hidden tape that unlocks a free cam (excellent for scouting) and contributes to unlocking a set of bonus levels. I haven't played all of these yet, but I'm told there's a huge tower gauntlet with a fierce leaderboard race. There's also a speedrun mode that times a run of the complete game, board skins, and a daily challenge.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/8e2VQoY7MCWFB4Vc8T9rve-1920-80.jpg

I am in awe of how unique and fun and fully-featured this thing is, and for $7. Frankly, it's an injustice that Stuntboost isn't one of the year's big indie success stories, but that's nothing new. The indie games that click for me always gravitate toward interesting movement mechanics or use of physics, and that rarely intersects with what PC gamers are currently going wild about (deckbuilders, autoshooters, and city builders mostly).

I've played lots of those—what I want are more games that make me feel alive and dangerous. Stuntboost has me vibrating in place, leaning into high-speed turns, and cursing a god I don't believe in. It's an intoxicating rush on a level I have not experienced before, and you should absolutely play it.

items.title: 新的《辐射 4》模组添加了整个城镇，但更重要的是，它可以让你加入帮派
items.summary: They're not the Tunnel Snakes, but they're trying.

content.v: There's nothing I like more in a Fallout game then stumbling across some weird little settlement filled with oddball characters. So when I saw that this mod for Fallout 4 added a whole new town called Detour that's built on top of an overpass near Bedford Station, that was an instant download.
Better yet, the mod features new quests and over a dozen new characters voiced by real people—no AI was used!

But there's something better than that , even. I was delighted to discover that the town of Detour has its own gang . It's a small gang, sure: the overpass Detour is built on isn't particularly big and the town itself is pretty tiny, so there's not a whole lot of room for different factions to spring up. But that doesn't stop the members of the Detour Degens from occupying one little corner of the town where they hang out in matching jackets, smoking cigs, chugging from beer bottles, and looking tough.
Sort of. Look, the Detour Degens are no Tunnel Snakes, that's for sure. But they live on an overpass. They're doing their best.

There are a few different types of missions you can do to raise your reputation with the town of Detour, and besides helping out the sheriff with bounties and recovering stolen goods for a few of the merchants, you can also get in good with the gang. The two members of the Degens I met told me that the third member, their leader, was locked up and they wanted me to spring him.
Yeah, there's a total of three members of the gang. Like I said, they're doing their best.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/7ctHB2pmW86ygpKYFSrxyS-1920-80.jpg

It was sort of amusing because the gang leader was locked up maybe 15 feet away from the gang's turf in an itty bitty jail cell in the cramped sheriff's office. But in keeping with Fallout tradition, there are a few ways to get the Degen's leader out of the clink.

Another gang mission was to tag various places around town with the Degen logo, which was also kinda cute. I don't really know why you'd need to advertise your gang in a town that small: surely, everyone knows you by now.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/9iJMq82qcnfyeNzDiJM2Me-1920-80.jpg

But I still did it because I wanna be in the smallest gang in Fallout history (except for maybe Maud's Muggers ). Once I tagged the town (it took maybe two minutes) they invited me to join them in a proper criminal quest. I won't spoil it, but like all good heists it went a little wrong in the middle and turned out fine in the end. Plus, the Detour Degens now have a new member, bringing the roster up to four people! I'll wear my new leather jacket proudly from now on.
You can download the Detour mod here , and I'll just point out again that it's been made without the use of AI, something that feels less and less common in the modding scene these days.

items.title: 《赛博朋克 2》副总监表示游戏任务团队一半人都是前模组制作者
items.summary: Cyberpunk 2 associate game director Pawel Sasko revealed that much of the game’s staff are actually former mod

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2025/11/26/ss-b20689e73e3ac19bcc5fad2c18d0353c769de144-1920x1080-1764175642324.jpg
Cyberpunk 2 associate game director Pawel Sasko revealed that a good chunk of the game’s staff are actually former modders who CD Projekt Red picked up to work on the highly-anticipated sequel.

Sasko made these comments during one of CDPR’s REDstreams on October 21, where the team discussed the bevy of exciting new updates coming to Cyberpunk 2077 . As part of this discussion, they explained their decision to introduce cross-platform support for PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2, and Xbox Series X|S, saying this was done both to keep the game fresh and to actively support the creativity of its modders.
In fact, the good folks at CDPR have actually partnered with modders in the game’s community as part of these updates, and even credited them with helping keep the title afloat.

“The modding community is really keeping the game alive,” Sasko said. “I’m very often looking at what our modders are doing, what they’re building. It’s very exciting. There’s so much creativity. We as a studio always try to support our modding community as much as we can.”

Adding onto this discussion, Sasko revealed that CDPR has sourced quite a few of its staff working on Cyberpunk 2 from the game’s modding scene, saying that around half of its quest team — designers who create a game’s objectives and storyline segments — are former modders.

"A lot of modders, they were players who actually first played and actually got experience with customizing the game with the mods," he said. "For me, this is a foot-in-the-door technique, and a gateway into game dev," he continues. "You can see, and you can learn how things are made, how things can be built. We actually hired so many modders. I would say, at this point, half of the quest team is all former modders."

While this isn’t a completely new revelation as far as CDPR is concerned (Sasko actually revealed this information back in 2024 ), it certainly couldn’t come at a funnier time, given the ongoing discussion around the differing sentiments toward community patches, mods, and emulation happening between Western players and Japanese fans on social media right now .

It’s an exciting era for Cyberpunk chooms; Edgerunners 2 just released on Netflix to rave reviews, alongside a host of new additions to the actual game, which include a dual-wielding playstyle, fresh cyberware customization options, and even a mode that gives you a tour through Night City, on top of cute references to the anime spinoff.

You can read our review for Edgerunners 2 here , as well as our interviews with producer Bartozs Szytbor, who told us all about Roman’s backstory and why the show’s ending wasn’t what audiences anticipated .

Returning to Cyberpunk 2077 or playing it for the first time? We’ve got a new and improved Cyberpunk interactive map to help you find every mission, Iconic item, and collectible in the game. Plus, we’ve also got a full walkthrough for the base game, a Phantom Liberty walkthrough , and an overview of all the Cyberpunk 2077 endings so you don’t make a choice you regret. And we can’t ignore the various romance options you can smooch, which also impact how V’s story concludes.

items.title: 亚马逊甚至在黑色星期五开始之前就对万智牌补充包进行了促销
items.summary: Save on Magic: The Gathering Play Booster Boxes at Amazon ahead of Black Friday, with discounts on Marvel, The

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/14/the-hobbit-booster-boxes-ign-1786699466644.png

Has Magic: The Gathering ever been as popular as it is right now? It feels like the long-running card game is having a bit of a moment in terms of bringing fresh players in via its ever-growing roster of Universes Beyond crossover properties.

Rightly or wrongly, that means there are more people looking to build collections, whether they’re playing or collecting the cards, and it just so happens that Amazon has rolled out some price cuts on Play Booster Boxes - including the Star Trek one at 26% off just weeks before it even launches .

It’s worth reminding you that these are Play Booster Boxes, as opposed to Collector Booster ones. Aside from a massive difference in price, Collector Boosters are where you’ll find the most valuable cards in each set. With that caveat out of the way, here are the best Play Booster Box deals we’ve found so far.
Save On Magic: The Gathering Play Booster Boxes

Sure, that Star Trek deal is great, but it’s not the only Universes Beyond property seeing a price cut. In fact, you can find discounts on both Marvel sets, The Hobbit, and Avatar: The Last Airbender.
If you’re desperate for the new Darkhold Destiny set announced for next year, then good news: You can save on both the Marvel Spider-Man and Super Heroes Play Booster Boxes.

The former, while not a great set, does have some cool cards, and while it would have cost you $209.70 around this time last year, it’s down to $134.95 for 30 packs. Meanwhile, the much better Super Heroes set from June of this year has dropped from the same MSRP to $149.99.

Sticking with 2026 sets, The Hobbit Play Booster Box has dropped down to $161.93, which marks a 23% discount. Whether you’re looking for Smaug, Gollum, Bilbo, or any of the dwarves from the set, this is a great way to build out a collection - and you get a box topper included, too.
Rounding out our Universes Beyond sale offerings is Avatar: The Last Airbender. This set was a very pleasant surprise, and you can grab a box of 30 packs for $139.99 right now .

For Universes Within, you’ve got a few options to build out your collection and deck-building options. Play Booster Boxes for Lorwyn Eclipsed, Secrets of Strixhaven, and even the current set, Reality Fracture, are currently discounted.

Lorwyn Eclipsed Play Boosters are down to $118 per box, but we’d recommend hanging fire for a little while. The same product was around $11 cheaper recently, and we can see this being ripe for a Black Friday saving.
Secrets of Strixhaven is still my favorite set of 2026, and if you missed all the fun, then you can catch up with a 21% discount on a Play Booster Box . 30 packs for $129.99? Don’t mind if I do.

Reality Fracture is a little different, because it’s being sold by a third-party seller . Still, it’s the current set and is sitting at $153.98, so you’re saving around $10 from the MSRP. Not huge, sure, but it’s an awesome set.
For more on Magic: The Gathering, be sure to check out all we know about next year’s sets so far , including some in-universe returns and another Marvel set.

content.v: 近日海盗船与CDPR合作，推出两套官方授权的限量游戏外设，设计分别取材于《 赛博朋克2077 》和动画《 赛博朋克 ：边缘行者2》。两套产品已于2026年10月22日开放预购。

另一套《赛博朋克：边缘行者2》系列取材于角色Roman Carax，将鲜艳配色、录音设备细节与动画视觉风格融入外观。该系列包含K65 PLUS WIRELESS键盘、HARPOON v2 WIRELESS鼠标、HS80 WIRELESS耳机和MM 2XL鼠标垫。

现有猜测主要指向两种可能：一是采用接近《GTAOL》完整线上模式，二是加入类似《无主之地》或《博德之门3》小规模合作体验。公司联合首席执行官Adam Badowski曾于2024年表示，团队正考虑在续作中加入“多人元素”。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261023/1792705531_891903.jpg
波兰分析师Mateusz Chrzanowski还预测，《赛博朋克2》可能于2030年第四季度推出，并可能因多人内容将总预算提高至4亿美元。相关时间与预算均未获得官方确认，多人玩法的规模、能否进入成品以及最终上线时间仍可能随开发计划调整。

items.title: Epic 宣布 Game Jam 必须使用 AI，然后又收回了要求
items.summary: The Unreal Engine and Fortnite company has extended the public a many-fingered invitation.

content.v: Unreal Engine maker Epic Games is running a game jam in November with thousands of dollars in prizes up for grabs. Contrary to so many art contests which ban the use of AI, participants in Epic's event aren't allowed to make their games without AI.

The theme of the 2026 Epic AI MegaJam will be revealed on November 11, and participating individuals and teams will then have from November 12–15 to produce their games with the help of AI tools (or else!).

Some will work in-person at a San Francisco event space, and there will be daily livestreams with progress updates. The winners in three categories will each receive $7,500, with smaller cash prizes for second and third place winners, as well as additional categories like "best team."

Epic extended the invitation with a reference to The Matrix's 'red pill' scene, presenting red-pilled AI-driven development as an opportunity to "ship awesome games in a weekend," while old-fashioned blue-pilled development would have you "wait months to prototype." The hand offering the red pill features an extra finger, a reference to the common mistake made by AI image generators.

The choice follows a recent pattern from Epic of aloofness and defiance directed at AI critics. Last week, the company referred to its new Epic Games Store launcher as "vibe coded," sending the message that it's not ashamed to rely heavily on AI for software development.
Vibe your way to 50K. The 2026 Epic AI MegaJam begins Nov 12: https://t.co/aAXEqj7zmE https://t.co/h3Kgs9Y5zH October 22, 2026

Following a report that Epic directed a team working on a Star Wars and Marvel crossover to pivot to "AI first" development, Epic founder and CEO Tim Sweeney said that the company is "moving developers around to retool for maximum AI acceleration."
The CEO is bullish on AI not just for coding, but for other fields as well, saying that he expects creative work to become more about "direction" than manual creation.

"Developers who are getting value from AI should speak up," Sweeney posted recently . "There's safety in numbers. MOST developers are doing it and loving it—and if they're not talking about it it's mostly out of fear for haters attacking them, their product, and their company."

Sweeney and Epic have received support for their AI positivity on X, but despite the platform's concentration of Grok users and aspiring AI entrepreneurs, substantial resistance also shows up in the replies.

"So do yall think you invented the concept of a game jam or what?" said one poster in response to the AI MegaJam announcement. "The ludum dare game jam was only 24 hours in 2002, so like, a quarter of the time as your game jam. but you want to make it look like its only possible with AI with this 'wait months to prototype.'"

others.title: 曝《战争机器》新作成本破5亿美元！还没算宣发费用

content.v: 《战争机器：事变日》制作成本据称超5亿美元，且尚未计入营销费用。第三方机构估算其首发阶段收入约为3700万美元，不到上述制作成本的10%，但两项数据均未得到Xbox或Coalition正式确认。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260923/1790172679_441079_jpg_r.jpg
消息称，如果5亿美元预算属实，本作可能成为Xbox成本最高的第一方游戏之一。游戏本月获得了较为稳健的评测成绩，但现阶段的商业表现似乎尚未与投入规模相匹配。
另有观点认为，Game Pass可能分流了本作在Xbox平台的直接销量。不过，这一影响同样没有官方数据佐证，无法据此确定订阅服务与首发收入之间的具体关系。
这笔预算也可能包含The Coalition升级开发技术的费用，以便未来更快制作后续作品。因此，全部投入未必都属于单款游戏的常规开发开支，相关技术成本也可能由系列未来作品逐步消化。
在Xbox积极裁员的背景下，如果本作后续销量未能提速，开发团队可能面临更大压力。目前有关制作成本、首发收入及Game Pass影响的说法仍来自媒体消息或第三方估算，最终数据应以Xbox或Coalition公布的信息为准。

content.v: 曼城前锋埃尔林·哈兰德近日公开了自己游玩《使命召唤：现代 战争 4》的习惯：他一直偏爱蹲点，也是其他玩家可能讨厌的那类对手。哈兰德还表示，这种打法可能会让自己招致批评。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261023/1792703601_210673_jpg_r.jpg

蹲点是《使命召唤》系列长期存在争议的打法。玩家通常守在角落，使用高威力武器等待目标出现，这样虽然能提高射击准确性，却可能拖慢强调高速交火的对局节奏。《使命召唤：现代战争4》正式发售前，官方社区内已经出现对局中蹲点者较多的抱怨，但这并非所有玩家的共同体验。
《使命召唤：现代战争4》将于10月23日发售，登陆PC、PS5、XSX|S和Switch2平台。

此次播放量反差也带有戏仿意味。《怪物史瑞克2重制版》的预告采用了与《GTA6》宣传活动相近的风格、配色和呈现方式，两个视频在同一频道的数据对比也因此成为话题。
《怪物史瑞克2重制版》由Aspyr开发，将于2026年11月10日登陆PC、PS5、XSX|S、Switch和Switch 2。游戏将改善画面，同时保留四人合作模式。

content.v: 《 任天堂明星大乱斗特别版 》总监樱井政博认为，生成式AI将继续推高游戏发行数量，其中多数作品可能难以盈利。快速制作和低质量批量生产还可能加剧玩法同质化，但AI无法复制创作者尚未形成的独特风格。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261023/1792703180_999072_jpg_r.jpg
樱井政博在接受日本媒体Denfaminicogamer采访时，以Steam的发行规模说明这一变化。他表示，2010年该平台共发布275款游戏，今年的数量则已超过1.9万款，人工智能可能让这一数字继续增长。面对庞大的发行量，玩家难以全面了解所有作品，大量游戏也可能无法获得收益。
在樱井政博看来，利用人工智能迅速制作或批量生产的低质量游戏，很可能只是重复其他作品已有的系统。他以整理书架、在草堆中找针等简单玩法为例，说明这类概念容易遭到复制。一款让玩家在500万根干草中寻找针的游戏走红后，很快便出现仿作，开发者甚至需要在Steam图片上标注“原创”。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20250721/1753059971_903314_jpg_r.jpg
樱井政博进一步表示，即便AI未来能够模仿《古堡迷踪》或《旺达与巨像》这类更复杂的作品，也无法复制上田文人今后尚未创造的艺术风格。他认为AI主要参照已有成果，因此能够走出自身道路、形成独特风格的人类创作者，在低质量内容大量出现的时代将愈发重要。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

content.v: 近日演员 黛布拉·威尔逊‌( Debra Wilson)表示，游戏角色频繁采用她的真实面貌，虽然带来了工作机会，却也可能妨碍玩家代入角色。她已经为超过100款游戏的重要角色配音，另有至少两位数的作品扫描并使用了她的面容。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261023/1792702198_606929_jpg_r.jpg
威尔逊‌理解部分玩家厌倦反复看到同一张脸，自己也并非始终喜欢这种做法。她提到，《自杀小队：杀死正义联盟》的Amanda Waller、《德军总部2：新巨像》的Grace Walker，以及《漫威金刚狼》的Callisto都与她本人相像。《漫威金刚狼》项目还曾希望扫描她原有的纹身，但被她拒绝。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261023/1792702199_620277.jpg
威尔逊‌并不反对所有外貌采集。《死亡搁浅2：冥滩之上》的多数主要演员都以本人形象出现，因此她接受这种统一的创作选择。她更在意的是，部分演员能够隐藏在虚拟角色之下，自己却经常被单独保留真实面貌。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261023/1792702199_444990_jpg_r.jpg
威尔逊‌认为演员应当服务于故事，并通过理解角色的情感核心进入不同的人生；如果熟悉的脸让玩家出戏，表演的魔力也会随之减弱。出演《战神：诸神黄昏》格萝雅时，她还刻意与另一位演员保持距离，以增强对手戏中的真实紧张感。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

此前公开的演示均来自PS5，但这并不意味着Xbox版本存在问题。XSX版可能与PS5版表现相近，XSS版实际运行情况则需要等待更多演示或游戏发售后验证。

items.title: Sabre Interactive 首席执行官表示，克莱夫·巴克 (Clive Barker) 的《猛鬼追魂：复兴》在 PC 和游戏机上的表现“非常出色”，并且还会推出更多游戏
items.summary: Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival has been a smash hit, says Saber Interactive CEO Matthew Karch in a post on

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/03/10/clivebarkershellrasierrevivaloriginsdeveloperdiaryvideo-ign-blogroll-1773154687012.jpg

Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival has been a smash hit, says Saber Interactive CEO Matthew Karch in a post on LinkedIn, and it’s the first of a “series” of releases from the studio that will improve how it makes games in the future.

Hellraiser: Revival has proven to be a smashing success, in spite of — or, perhaps because of — its super-spicy content. The game doesn’t skirt around the sex, blood, and gore that defined the source material, causing some content creators to get permanently banned despite taking pains to censor their playthroughs.

In an October 19 LinkedIn post, Saber Interactive CEO Matthew Karch praised the Hellraiser development team, revealing the title has been performing “extremely well on PC and console” since its October 8 release.

He also speculated that AAA titles with massive budgets and lengthy development timelines won’t be sustainable in the industry for much longer (if, indeed, they are right now), instead positing that AA games based on established IPs with smaller budgets are likely a more realistic path forward.

“The game is testament to the notion that an established IP and solid AA development with controlled costs can produce great results and high user scores,” he wrote. “I believe a greater focus on these middle-market IP-driven products, rather than AAA behemoths, is the future to maintaining growth and momentum in the game industry.

“While I believe there will always be a place for the properly-developed and budgeted AAA experience, a AA game that provides a great immersive experience for a lower price is less risky and can provide much greater returns on average.”

Karch went on to say that Hellraiser: Revival is “the first in a series of releases by Saber that will continue to prove out our methodology,” teasing that there’s “more to come in just a few short weeks.”

While IGN scored the game a six out of ten , Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival boasts a “very positive” player score on Steam , and has earned no small amount of praise from content creators who showed up in droves to broadcast the game on release.
Of course, given its content, it’s no surprise that some streamers got the ban hammer — but, according to its developers, that’s exactly what they were aiming for when they made it.

"It was an unofficial goal of the team to be banned, unrated, or restricted at least somewhere in the world as one barometer of whether we’d done our jobs right,” narrative director Antony De Fault told IGN in an exclusive interview .
Even Clive Barker himself was impressed , saying he was “fearful at one point that the game would be overly censored but I’m genuinely astonished by how far they’ve been able to push it.”

https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261023/1792700371_270126.jpg
近日制作人平野真之在采访中表示，《 龙珠：超宇宙2 》销量已超过1000万套。团队认为，进入原作世界战斗的体验在前作中已得到较充分呈现，因此希望新作带来一个玩家从未见过的《龙珠》世界。团队与鸟山明及相关各方讨论后，最终确定了AGE 1000这一故事方向，并会保留与历代角色修行、并肩作战的传统内容。

content.v: Circana公布的美国9月硬件市场数据显示，Xbox Series主机销量同比下降27%，跌至Xbox品牌历年9月最低水平，同时刷新了一年前创下的同期低点。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261023/1792700204_297484_jpg_r.jpg
同期各平台表现明显分化。PS5销量同比增长22%，销售额增长43%，索尼主导了当月主机市场。不过，PS5当前售价高于一年前，销售额增幅不能完全视为销量增幅。
Switch 2销量同比下降12%，其自2025年6月上市以来的高速增长势头有所放缓。但该机仍明显领先初代Switch同期表现，继续保持任天堂销售速度最快主机的地位。
对于Xbox销量下滑，GameSpot分析认为，微软近年来强调第一方游戏跨平台发行、云游戏以及“任何设备都可以是Xbox”的品牌思路，可能削弱了消费者购买客厅主机的必要性。这一说法属于媒体分析，Circana数据只能确认市场结果，无法单独证明相关策略与销量下滑之间存在因果关系。
Xbox目前正尝试重新强调主机独占内容，并计划延长Series X|S产品周期，同时筹备价格较高的Project Helix主机。相关业务还在新任Xbox负责人Asha Sharma领导下进行调整，并伴随裁员。

items.title: 《半条命 3》再次确认：Valve 开发者刚刚大声说出“HLX”
items.summary: There's no mistaking it this time—he said it.

others.title: 为什么人们认为 Valve 只是意外确认了《半条命 3》
Valve 开发者错误地提及了传闻中的《半条命 3》代号

content.v: Get ready to start talking about Half-Life 3 again, folks, because it's that time of year: Winter is closing in, The Game Awards are coming, and somebody at Valve said "HLX."
HLX, for those who haven't been following along, is a rumored codename for Half-Life 3, or Half-Life something, the near-mythical new Half-Life game that Valve may or may not be working on.

It first appeared in early 2024 as part of a data string inside a Counter-Strike 2 update that bore a very strong resemblance to "HLVR," Valve's codename for Half-Life: Alyx—a revelation that had PC Gamer contributor Rick Lane "vibrating with excitement."

Sadly for Rick, nothing came of it: No new Half-Life game, 3 or otherwise, followed, and HLX was filed away with all the other myriad Half-Life 3 rumors, hoaxes, and leaks . That is, until Valve composer and audio artist Mike Morasky brought it up completely out of the blue during a GameSoundCon panel on "Valve's Approach to an Open and Flexible Audio Engine."

In response to a question about managing voice counts—essentially the maximum number of sounds that can play simultaneously—Morasky touched on some of the variables involved, before mentioning the role played by Valve's HDR system in optimizing audio. "Deadlock has their own version of HDR," Morasky says. "HLX has its own version, and so on and so forth."
We have the first mention of HLX by a Valve employee.HLX files today. I'm working as quickly as I can. https://t.co/LhFBNOP1CU October 22, 2026

Adding fuel to the fire, co-panelist David Feise, seated next to Morasky, immediately turned to him after the HLX comment and whispered "nice work," or possibly "nice one," obviously suggesting, hey man, you're not supposed to talk about that. Feise then quickly puts an end to the answer as Morasky laughs nervously, saying Groups, which Morasky had been talking about leading up to the HLX remark, "is its own one-hour talk, so come talk to us about that afterwards."

There's no question that Morasky said HLX, and that Feise reacted. In fact, at the end of the panel Feise leaned in and said, "Good job, you only said HLX once." Because this isn't the first time he's done it: Morasky appeared oh-so-close to saying "HLX" in 2025, although he was able to catch himself midway and shift gears, awkwardly, to "Alyx."
- "good job you only said HLX once" - "I DID?" https://t.co/gb8vxACxIi October 22, 2026

So HLX does seem to be a thing, but exactly what type of thing is anyone's guess. Maybe he's tripping over Half-Life: Alyx, or referring to some bit of internal tech, or maybe the whole thing is all just a put-on—Valve devs having a little fun with us. Or maybe it really is Half-Life 3! Nobody knows.

It is interesting, though, that PC Gamer editor Tyler Wilde—a man who does not indulge in the frivolity of baseless rumor and speculation—said in 2025, as the previous round of Half-Life 3 rumors was heating up, that he does think Valve is working on a new Half-Life game (although not necessary Half-Life 3), and that "it's not unreasonable to believe that a new Half-Life game will be announced within the next year or so." Here we are, a year later—and a year closer? We'll see.
"Valve's Approach to an Open and Flexible Audio Engine" panel can be seen in full on Vimeo .

content.v: GTA 6 's marketing push is ramping up substantially, and that includes with TV commercials. Eagled-eyes fans have discovered that the new GTA 6 TV spots actually contain some extended sequences, but just barely.

For starters, a 30-second TV spot cuts out the steamy shower scenes with Jason and Lucia from the launch trailer . While the shower scenes are gone in this edit, the new TV spot has a slightly longer shots of an airplane sequence and another with Jason and Lucia standing next to their car.

Jason playfully nudges Lucia, and in the TV spot, she nearly topples to the ground. The Xbox logo was also removed, presumably due to Rockstar's reported promotional deal with Sony. You can check out the comparison below ( via IGN ).

A 90-second version, meanwhile, includes the shower scenes, along with the slightly longer sequences seen in the 30-second version. If you saw these TV spots recently, you might not have even noticed any of these changes, but GTA 6 fan accounts are extremely dedicated and never miss anything.

GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and, yes, Xbox Series X|S, even though the TV ads for the game don't tell you that. Rockstar's marketing push for the game also includes real-life Burger Shot and Cluckin' Bell restaurants where you can buy GTA-branded food .

In other GTA 6 news, it was recently reported that preorders are pacing significantly ahead of any other big AAA game of the past five years . Obviously that's no surprise, given GTA 6 is expected to be the biggest game release ever, and it could generate $2 billion before it even launches.

content.v: Whether you were able to tune in live (thanks!) or you're dropping by to get a tl;dr, we're here to give you a recap of some highlights from today's community stream :

As you may remember, back in 10.1.0, we updated how MMR is calculated. While kills and escapes continue to be an aspect of MMR calculations, they are no longer the only thing used to calculate these values. Now, we also factor in a wide range of actions that help progress the game – think, emblems.

Of course, certain aspects of the MMR have stayed the same. Namely, Killers keep their individual MMR ratings, Survivor share their MMR, matchmaking prioritizes wait times over exact MMR matching, and MMR gains/losses are calculated by comparing Killers and Survivors against each other in a match.
Since making this change in 10.1.0, we've been keeping a close eye on this system and recently noticed that Survivors' Altruism wasn't giving as much MMR as it should have.

To make sure altruistic play is correctly rewarded, we made an adjustment to our MMR system earlier this week (thanks to the adjustable elements of the algorithm), increasing this value. We'll continue to keep a close eye on how this impacts players' MMR and matchmaking before making any further changes.
Last update, we adjusted over 50 perks, focusing on improving generic perks and those that were affected by Diminishing Returns and could use an adjustment.
Watching the results of these changes, we saw some shifts in the usage and kill / escape rates for these perks. Here's a recap of which ones saw the biggest increases and decreases:
KILLER USAGE
📈 Scourge Hook: Monstrous Shrine
📈 Undone
📈 Help Wanted

KILL RATES

ESCAPE RATES

📉 Self-Preservation
PERK ADJUSTMENTS
As a follow-up to last update's perk changes, we're making further adjustments to some perks that were tweaked in 10.2.0! Here's a recap of the changes:
Calm Spirit : We felt the Action Speed bonus was a little low, so it's increasing to 25%.
Dark Sense : This perk can sometimes trigger at inopportune times and we don't want you to feel like its uses are wasted. We're adding a token system so you can "bank" its activations.

Dark Arrogance : We know many of you really liked this perk back on the 10.2.0 PTB, so we're continuing to tweak it to capture its PTB feeling without being too strong. We're increasing Successful Basic Attack cooldown to 15%, reducing Window Vault Speed to 15%, adding Missed Basic Attack cooldown to penalties, and reducing the penalties to 15%. And of course, we will continue to monitor how this goes!

items.title: EA 裁员后我非常担心 Skate
items.summary: Publisher Electronic Arts recently slashed 400 roles across its company , which resulted in the shuttering of

content.v: Publisher Electronic Arts recently slashed 400 roles across its company , which resulted in the shuttering of legendary RPG studio BioWare . But also impacted by the layoffs was Skate developer Full Circle, and now I'm growing increasingly worried about the future of a franchise I waited so long to make a comeback.

Part of EA's latest round of layoffs on October 21 included cutting an unspecified number of staffers to create a "very clear roadmap" that leads to a "healthier and more sustainable business." Then, as VGC noted on the same day , "many" of the developers at Full Circle are gone. This includes artists Brendan Vermeltfoort and Will Granda, seasonal creative director John Epler, and senior designers Adam Martinazzi and David Milne--all of whom posted the unfortunate news on LinkedIn.

It's always a bummer when talented developers lose their jobs at the hands of corporate greed, but this one stings for me personally. As a big Skate girlie, I was so stoked for the franchise to make a comeback, and even more stoked to get my hands on the game in September 2025.

It's had its stumbles, to be sure. Season 2 was light on new content. Season 3 introduced a new map ... that was locked behind a paywall. Season 4 gave us an empty stadium ... that was also locked behind a paywall. But despite bailing on every trick, you could see Full Circle getting closer to landing at each attempt. Season 5, which kicked off on September 8, hasn't been the best, but it has been a solid step in the right direction, and even came with a massive park reminiscent of Skate 3 's Super Ultra Mega Park.

Along the way, there have been new tricks, new attempts at progression (that oftentimes drew the ire of the player base), a smattering of new gear, and a plethora of bug fixes to make each season a bit smoother than the last (though there were inevitably bugs with each new content drop). It was evident that Full Circle, which is composed of developers who worked on the entire Skate franchise, wanted to make the best Skate game possible after the series went dormant for 15 years. The team just needs time to cook. After all, Skate was never a live-service franchise, and I don't think it ever needed to be one.

This is what has me worried about the game's future. While EA seems to be committed to keeping Skate online (for now), the team has to be much smaller now--especially after Full Circle suffered layoffs in February. Game development is already hard, and I imagine running a live-service is even harder. Doing that with fewer staff sounds even more challenging.

While we don't know the exact number of layoffs at Full Circle, I just want Skate to succeed. I've waited over a decade for the franchise to make a comeback, and I'm having a hard time watching it suffer because profits matter more than the people who make the product. There's genuine good in the game, and the team was finally hitting its stride. I just hope that EA gives Full Circle the time--and resources--it needs to realize its vision.

items.summary: In a recent interview with GameSpot, actor Debra Wilson, who you might recognize from Star Wars Jedi: Fallen O

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2025/03/09/death-stranding-2-on-the-beach-pre-order-trailer-mp4-00-05-58-14-still058-1741556849892.jpg

In a recent interview with GameSpot , actor Debra Wilson, who you might recognize from Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order , Wolfenstein: The New Colossus , or God of War Ragnarok , said she’s sick of seeing her face in video games. The actor said the developers choose it and she’d rather play characters that don’t resemble her.

“I don’t necessarily dig it,” Wilson said. “Because I might as well be doing it on camera. It's hard to suspend your disbelief. There are people who are like, ‘Oh my God, she's in every f***ing game. What the f***?’ And there are other people like, ‘I am sick of looking at her face because I just want to play the game and not think of Debra Wilson.’”
It’s become a bit of a meme in gaming communities, with players complaining that they’re being taken out of the experience because they’ve seen Wilson’s face pop up.

“I don't blame them because I feel the same,” she said. “Why do you have to show my face? Amanda Waller in Suicide Squad, Grace Walker in Wolfenstein: The New Colossus, and now with the new Wolverine game coming out, I'm Callisto. Guess who the f*** she looks like?

“They wanted to scan my original tattoos. I was like, ‘Now you're pushing it. No, you're pushing that s**t.’ So I have been grateful for the work that has come in the video game industry where my characters are European.”

Later in the interview, she talked about how she wouldn’t want to include it as a contract stipulation because she wants artists to be able to tell stories in whatever way they like. But as an actor who’s played demons, dragons, and all sorts of other non-human entities, it doesn’t really capture what she’s capable of.
She also noted that it depends on the game. In Death Stranding 2, her likeness was used but so was almost every other actor’s.
“I am not upset at their choice to do that because everybody looks like themselves,” she said. “[Hideo Kojima] knew what he wanted. He's more than a director. He's an artist.”
Wilson recently starred as Jessica Pike in Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve, Callisto in Marvel’s Wolverine, and did background voices in Modern Warfare 4.

items.title: 未来的 Capcom 游戏将感谢《鬼武者》对 RE 引擎的粗糙肢解
items.summary: Surely this will come in handy for the next Resident Evil.

content.v: Onimusha: Way of the Sword has received universal praise for its combat animations, which somehow manage to look natural and fluid no matter what angle or direction hero Miyamoto Musashi has to swing his sword to parry an incoming blow. In a post-launch interview, I asked Capcom how—beyond doing a ton of work across Onimusha's lengthy development—they managed to raise the bar for this sort of action game.

"Starting the project six years ago, we felt it was important to have that detail to sell the power and the excitement of the action, so it's something we really focused on," said director Satoru Nihei.

"Even at that starting point, we knew it was something that Capcom, as a company, have as a great strength: We have a lot of assets and tech available to us that allow us to create these varieties of actions. That's something we really felt we could leverage to make the game really stand out that a lot of other places can't really copy. On top of producing a lot of animations and motion capture, we have to give a lot of credit to the programmers for taking that data and putting it in a form that we can have them make these very smooth transitions, with these physics-based calculations, to go from one animation to another. It was a big team effort in getting the animations to look how they do."
PC Gamer actually got a behind-the-scenes look at that process when we traveled to Osaka this summer to see Onimusha: Way of the Sword wrapping up development.

The effort put into Onimusha's animations is even more impressive within the scope of the final game and its roster of intricately choreographed boss fights. Despite being the third of Capcom's three big releases this year, following Resident Evil: Requiem and Pragmata, Onimusha features some fancy samurai dismemberment tech new to the publisher's in-house game engine. Rather than factoring into the more scripted boss fights, it comes into play when Musashi chops weaker enemies into pieces with dramatic finishers like the lightning fast Issen strike.

"One particular piece of technology that was added specifically for this title that we couldn't have done before is what we call the dynamic dismemberment system," Nihei said. "If you slash enemies with certain attacks they get cut in the exact path that a sword passes through. While that's something that has been done in the past in other games, one of the challenges and things we built on that was brand new with Onimusha was having that happen along with enemies still being animated as they're dying and dropping.

"In lots of other games you'd cut them, they'd kind of freeze when you do the cut and then fall apart. We had to have the programmers add to RE Engine to be able to enable that to really sell the impact of moves like the Issen. That was something brand new added to the engine."

This isn't the first time Nihei has talked about Onimusha's dismemberment system, but I followed up by contrasting it with other action games like Metal Gear Rising: Revengeance, which go a bit more freeform with their chopping. Nihei said that the Onimusha team knew they didn't want to go that route even early in development.

"In other games where you have that ability to cut up anything—just because of the tempo and style of game we wanted to make, it wasn't something we considered for Onimusha. Choosing exactly which direction and how you want to cut, we didn't think it was a good match for this particular title. Rather, we wanted to have something that happened reactively to how you're playing, to show off the power of the abilities."

Now that Onimusha's dynamic dismemberments are bedded into RE Engine, I hope they'll show up in Capcom's future games. Surely next time Leon blows a zombie in half with a shotgun its guts will be slipping and sliding all over the place.

items.title: 魔兽世界：永远保守秘密
items.summary: World of Warcraft: Forever players may have searched its beta with a fine-toothed comb, but Blizzard said ther

content.v: World of Warcraft: Forever players may have searched its beta with a fine-toothed comb, but Blizzard said there are still plenty of secrets waiting to be found come launch and beyond.

In a new WoW: Forever Podcast dedicated to the end of the beta, Blizzard made clear it's keeping many of the game's surprises close to its chest. Senior game designer Josh Greenfield said Blizzard had disabled some items and secrets for the beta. He gave an example of a new torch item that was originally turned off for the beta's first week, but later enabled to test out Forever's new lighting and fog tech. He said players can expect more of those types of surprises.

"There's definitely some secrets and stuff that we had turned off," Greenfield said when asked about still to be discovered secrets in the level 1-30 zones. "There's going to be things to discover that we didn't surface, suffice to say that."

Forever's beta had a maximum level of 30, meaning there is still a huge chunk of the game, including new zones, quests, dungeons, and raids, players haven't fully explored yet. When asked about items like a newly discovered sword in the beta that could potentially enable new playstyles, like a melee-focused "Battle Mage", Greenfield opted not to elaborate further.

"It's hard to talk about secret stuff," Greenfield said. "It's secret, right? We want people to find it. There's some really, really, really cool, and really, really, really well-buried stuff out there that's probably going to take people a long time to find. If we tip our hats to it too much, it's just going to take the fun away."

Unlike in past WoW releases, most of the items on Forever's beta were hidden from dataminers using a new system that hides an item's name and stats until it's discovered by the community. At the start of the beta, over 12,500 items were kept hidden . As a result, players don't know what items drop from dungeon bosses or what some of the best quest rewards are. The game is still a mystery, something Greenfield said is cool to experience "organically" for those who know WoW Classic like the back of their hand.

Blizzard did give some more concrete teases towards the end of the podcast. Lead encounter designer Michael Nuthals said Blizzard is already laying the groundwork for Forever's future, and as such players may find examples of places that could be future dungeons already in the game.

"There might be some homes, some manors, out there that folks have found that might be something interesting in the future," Nuthals said, seemingly referencing the new Manor Mistmantle in the game's Duskwood zone. "You might have seen some instance portals hiding in some inconspicuous spots. There are some things coming in the future and we're really excited to share those as we get there."
A roadmap released during BlizzCon 2026 shows Blizzard is planning to release new dungeons and raids for Forever next year.

WoW: Forever launches November 4. In other Forever news, Blizzard announced a new server ruleset that will make PvP players happy. As for where Forever will take players in the future, Blizzard said in an interview with GameSpot that while the team is committed to staying on Azeroth, it's open to exploring places players may have already seen before in other WoW expansions. Meanwhile, a leaked survey revealed 11 new classes that could potentially come to Blizzard's old-school MMO.

items.title: 战争机器：E-Day 显然花费了 50 亿美元制作
items.summary: Multiple new reports claim that the budget for Gears of War: E-Day was $500 million. Both Kotaku and Chris Dri

content.v: Multiple new reports claim that the budget for Gears of War: E-Day was $500 million. Both Kotaku and Chris Dring of The Game Business reported today, with Kotaku's report saying the number does not include marketing costs.

Jez Corden of Windows Central added that the $500 million figure is not wrong, but his own sources aren't able to say definitively if that number covers the game's budget alone, or the game's budget plus additional costs related to running the development studio, The Coalition.

Whatever the case, the consensus seems to be that E-Day was an expensive game to produce, and the game's early sales results do not seem very impressive. The game reportedly sold 230,000 copies across Xbox and PC , but that doesn't tell the whole story since the game is included with Xbox Game Pass . Further data shows that the game reached nearly 2 million people out of the gate, and that number is sure to grow over time.

Game Pass is a juggernaut for Microsoft and Xbox, with its recurring revenue from subscriptions generating almost $5 billion annually based on the latest data. A $500 million development budget for E-Day would represent 10% of that annual revenue from Game Pass.

Industry expert Mike Futter reacted to Kotaku's report about E-Day's $500 million budget, saying, "Exclusivity on console games simply does not make sense right now," even if the development budget was half of that.

E-Day was expected to release on PS5, and Microsoft's own presentational materials showed that , but the game was not released on Sony's console. According to reports, Microsoft canceled a PS5 edition at the last minute, with others saying E-Day was being sent out to die on purpose .
GameSpot has contacted Xbox seeking comment about E-Day's reported budget.
Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has said one of her ambitions is to bring back exclusives , following the previous leadership under Phil Spencer and Sarah Bond embracing multiplatform releases.
E-Day is a prequel to the Gears series, telling the story of Emergence Day. The game got generally solid review scores, including a 7/10 here at GameSpot.

No new Gears of War games have been confirmed, but developers at The Coalition have said the foundation is in place now to make an E-Day sequel faster. Beyond any possible new games, Netflix is producing a Gears of War movie and TV series .

We are finally under a month away from one of the most anticipated pop culture events ever: the release of Grand Theft Auto 6. It's been over 13 years since GTA 5 was released, and a new entry is finally almost here. Similar to many of Rockstar's games, GTA 6 looks to push graphical fidelity in many ways. If you're still playing on PS4 or Xbox One, you will not be able to play, as the game will only launch on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

However, there's still time to pick up a new console, and trading in your old gaming system is a great way to make that transition more affordable. As you look for console trade-in benefits everywhere, PayMore is a great option.
Earn $10 Store Credit When You Trade-In Your Used Console at PayMore

Right now, electronics resale franchise, PayMore is offering a new Level Up program that gives you a $10 PayMore promotional credit in addition to your regular cash offer. This can be put toward a PlayStation 5 or Xbox Series X, meaning you'll have everything you need to play GTA 6 . This offer lasts through November 20 at participating locations. You'll just need to check if there's a store near you first:
Find Your Nearest PayMore Location

Current-generation consoles likely aren't going anywhere for a long while due to the component shortage, so purchasing one today is not something you'll likely regret. With demand for essential components continuing to climb, too, there's no telling if current prices will hold.
What Is PayMore?
If you haven't heard of PayMore until now, it's a top-rated electronics buyer with stores across the U.S., specializing in purchasing your old smartphones, tablets, laptops, and of course, consoles.
How it works

Simply put, if you're looking to sell electronics, you can bring them to a PayMore store and get a free evaluation using real-time market pricing software, and walk out with cash. The store aims to keep the process transparent and fair, taking into account the condition, age, and market demand. It seems worth checking out as you explore your console trade-in options right now.
Tips When Selling at PayMore
1. Bring your cables with you
Bring along any cables, accessories, or the original box that came with your device, along with warranty cards or paperwork if you still have them.
2. Charge up first, if you can
To save time, charge your device before visiting so they can test it quickly. If you can’t charge it or don’t have the charger, they'll do it for you in-store.

items.title: 前工作室老板表示 EA 可能会出售 BioWare 的 IP，以解决巨额债务问题
items.summary: It's a grim week for developers and fans, with EA announcing that it is shutting down Mass Effect and Dragon A

content.v: It's a grim week for developers and fans, with EA announcing that it is shutting down Mass Effect and Dragon Age studio BioWare. EA said that after deciding not to pursue development on a new Mass Effect, it would shut down the studio as part of company-wide restructuring plans that will result in roughly 400 employees being let go. But should EA sit on the IP that BioWare was responsible for and let it gather dust? Former BioWare executive producer Mark Darrah has suggested they could go up for sale as it works off some of its $55 billion debt.

"Remember BioWare, 100% owned by EA," Darrah said on his YouTube channel. “EA owns all the IP. They own Dragon Age, they own Mass Effect, they own Jade Empire. That doesn’t change the situation. Now, here’s nobody working on a game, or games, within the EA organization, and chances are there never will be, which might make them more likely to sell off those IP. But it might also make them more likely to just try to forget that they ever existed and bury them in the vault. I think we still are going to have to wait a little bit before we see if EA has any interest in selling off some of its dormant IP. Right now, they seem to be in cost-control mode. They might start into a revenue-generation mode where selling IP might be more desirable."

Earlier this year, former Dragon Age lead writer David Gaider also spoke about the franchise and said he believed it was dead after the poor commercial performance of Dragon Age: The Veilguard. BioWare's last game failed to meet EA's expectations, and mass layoffs at BioWare eventually left only a core team to focus on the next Mass Effect game . While EA doesn't have anyone internally to work on a game based on a BioWare IP, that doesn't mean it can't look outward to find a studio to handle work on a new Mass Effect or Jade Empire--if it chooses to.

For example, Konami has successfully resurrected its Silent Hill series in recent years, teaming up with developers like Bloober Team, Screen Burn, and NeoBards Entertainment to produce several critically acclaimed games in the IP. Following the success of Bit Reactor's Star Wars Zero Company and Fuse Games’ Star Wars: Galactic Racer , Lucasfilm Games says it wants to be more flexible in choosing who it partners with, and fans can expect some surprises in the future.

Beyond the sad news about BioWare, EA also announced that work on the new Sims game has been paused, the team behind the new Skate game is being downsized, and a "social-first open-world” football game is in development.

items.title: Splash Damage 在解雇了一批人后仅 3 个月就收购了这家工作室——现在它也在解雇他们
items.summary: An undisclosed number of employees have been let go from the studio behind survival game Scum.

content.v: The closure of BioWare and layoff of roughly 400 people at Electronic Arts is being rightly excoriated as an example of the corrosive effects of capital on pretty much everything good. But that same sort of thing happens, maybe more often than we'd like to think, on smaller scales, too. Case in point: Gamepires, creator of open-world survival game Scum , which announced last week that it's putting people out of work.

The bad news came via an unattributed message posted on X : "A difficult decision has been made to reduce the size of the Gamepires team, which means saying goodbye to colleagues who've helped shape Scum and the studio. This step is necessary to help Gamepires adapt to challenging market conditions and long-term sustainability."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/X6aP4mrbYBNu4zbh6Yi7cR-1920-80.jpg
It's all very bloodless and generic—the sort of statement that could've come from just about any game studio making layoffs over the past six months or so.

What makes this particular case feel so egregious, though, is that Gamepires was acquired by Splash Damage Group , in a deal backed by Emona Capital, just eight months ago. And that acquisition was made just three months after Splash Damage made major layoffs of its own, so it could "remain agile and adaptable in what has been a very challenging market." And those layoffs came just two months after Splash Damage was acquired by then-unnamed private equity investors .

Splash Damage hasn't released a game since Gears Tactics in 2020: Its planned next big thing, Transformers: Reactivate, was cancelled in 2025. Gamepires' survival game Scum, meanwhile, is still ticking over nicely on Steam, where it's being regularly updated with hotfixes and content updates.

In fact, Splash Damage said when it acquired Gamepires that "bringing the teams together around Scum gives Splash Damage Group immediate, meaningful work to focus on," adding, "That stability has been important for protecting roles and giving the studio a solid foundation for its future. Splash Damage Group is currently just under 150 people, and we will be working closely with Emona to grow the group over the next few years."
Yet here we are, eight months later.
So, to recap:
The number of people put out of work wasn't revealed, but in response to our inquiry Splash Damage issued the following statement:
"Gamepires is part of Splash Damage Group and has reduced the size of its team in response to challenging market conditions and to support the studio’s long-term sustainability.

"These redundancies have affected colleagues we work closely with, whose work has helped make SCUM what it is today. We know this is difficult news for those leaving. We have great respect for their work and the contribution they’ve made to both the game and the studio.
"Development of SCUM will continue, and we’ll keep working with our colleagues at Gamepires to support updates and new content."

items.title: 万智牌 Foundations Commander Precons 在亚马逊有现货，建议零售价 - 但有一个问题
items.summary: Amazon is selling MTG's rare Foundations precons again for MSRP, but there's a catch.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/16/foundations-new-commander-decks-ign-1786611754869-1792143473386.png
Magic: The Gathering's new Foundations Commander decks launched alongside the current set, Reality Fracture, and are intended to offer a nice “on-ramp” for new players to jump into the format.
There are five mono-colored decks to collect, and while $30 a pop is a great deal, they’ve been tough to find for MSRP — or at all, depending on where you look.

Thankfully, Amazon has restocked the lot , but there is a catch: You’ll need to buy a bundle of all five. Sadly, you’ll need to pay over the odds to buy them piecemeal, which is admittedly an annoyance if you’ve managed to grab one or two already.
MTG’s Foundation Decks Are Back To MSRP In This Bundle
Despite an MSRP of $30, they’re climbing a little; some of these decks have been reaching as high as $60 (we see you, Tramplesaurus Rex).
Whether we’ve had a fresh print run or not (we’ve asked Wizards of the Coast and are awaiting confirmation either way), it seems more product has made it to store shelves.

The best part is that you can’t really go wrong with any of them. Reign of Dragons is a fun, aggressive deck that’s all about dragons in red, while Wretched Ranks is ripe for upgrades but still fun to build an army of zombies with.

Keen Engineering will teach you the fun of mono-blue (I use that loosely) by having you outmaneuver your foes, and Calling All Angels is a surprisingly powerful precon that’s unsurprisingly all about angels.

So, what about Tramplesaurus Rex ? This mono-green behemoth is all about big creatures that swing for big damage. It’s not the most technical of decks, but there are some handy mana ramp cards that’ll slot into any other deck that has access to green. Sadly, it’s still up for $79.95 (via a third-party seller), and I can’t say enough how you should NOT PAY THAT.

As for whether they’re worth buying or not, that depends on how much you’re paying and where you are in your Magic: The Gathering journey. There are alternate arts here for each of the five Commanders, but other than that, each deck is just reprints that you might be happy with - or they might not be for you.
As we said back when these were announced, Starter Decks for Commander are not a new notion, but they’ve not been printed in so long that those ones climbed in price in the years since.
For more on Magic: The Gathering, be sure to check out Reality Fracture’s priciest cards , as well as all we know about the Warhammer 40K Commander decks seeing a reprint .

items.title: 《魔兽世界》：Forever 正在根据大众需求推出新的服务器选项
items.summary: World of Warcraft: Forever players are getting a fourth server "ruleset" option for launch: role-playing-playe

content.v: World of Warcraft: Forever players are getting a fourth server "ruleset" option for launch: role-playing-player vs. player, or RP-PvP for short.

Blizzard announced the news on social media , stating the server would be open for name reservations starting on October 27. It joins three other rulesets for players to choose from, with options for PvE, PvP, and roleplaying. Yet another server ruleset, Hardcore (aka permadeath), is set to be added before Spring 2027.

The addition of a RP-PvP server is good news for the game's community, who have been vocal about wanting to see it added as an option. RP-PvP servers have been included in past versions of WoW Classic and WoW.

Having another PvP server option has taken on new importance given Blizzard's server approach for Forever. Rather than multiple different servers for each ruleset, Blizzard instead opted for what is essentially one massive server for each. That means prior to now there was only one PvP server, and unsurprisingly, it's that server where much of the game's streamer population and their audiences will be playing. One of those streamers is the controversial Asmongold, whose Alliance guild, Olympus, currently numbers over 74,000 players on Forever's beta.

Many WoW Classic players would rather avoid streamer drama and Asmongold's army disrupting their experience, but didn't have anywhere else to go if they were committed to playing on a PvP server. Now, with a RP-PvP server, those players have somewhere to go, albeit with some extra RP-focused rules to contend with.
Blizzard originally seemed hesitant to introduce a RP-PvP server. Just last week, Blizzard said it had no plans to introduce one.

"Whenever it comes to RP-PVP, people really remember fondly stuff like Grobbulus in 2019, but unfortunately, the reality is every other RP-PVP realm we've done since then has followed a different trajectory…," senior game designer Josh Greenfield said in a PvP-focused episode of the WoW: Forever podcast . "It's one of those things where we'd want to make a decision based on hopes and what we want; we have to make decisions based on what has actually played out and actual player behavior."

He went on to state the game's RP community is "pretty small" compared to its normal and PvP communities, and that for Blizzard's new "realmless" ruleset system to work, it needs a "critical mass" of players to encourage social interactions and for the server to have a strong economy.
"Taking that already tight-knit community and splitting it again is something we have to carefully consider in this new world," he said.
GameSpot reached out to Blizzard for comment on what changed its mind and why it decided to add another server option, but has not yet heard back as of publication.

WoW: Forever launches on November 4. Even with less than two weeks before launch, Blizzard continues to deliver new information about the third version of its popular MMO. It recently revealed players can expect to see the return of a questing tradition in the game's new Riverglades zone and made big changes to Forever's racial abilities . In an interview with GameSpot, Blizzard teased how it's approaching Forever's endgame and its future .

items.title: 足球明星埃尔林·哈兰德是《使命召唤》露营者，我真的很讨厌它
items.summary: There's nothing worse than running around a Call of Duty map, clicking heads and feeling awesome, then getting

content.v: There's nothing worse than running around a Call of Duty map, clicking heads and feeling awesome, then getting your head blown off out of nowhere, watching the killcam, and seeing that it was a camper. Apparently, that camper could've been Manchester City striker Erling Haaland because he's been a camper his whole life.

In an October 21 video on his YouTube channel , the Norwegian soccer superstar was 1-v-1-ing English rapper Harrison "Aitch" Armstrong in Modern Warfare 4 . Very early in the video, Aitch asks how Haaland tends to play CoD games. Haaland came through with some honesty.

"You know what, and this is a bit embarrassing to say, but I've been a camper my whole life," Haaland told Aitch. "I'm that guy that you hate. [I'll] probably get some hate now, but it is what it is."
Well, you know what, Haaland? You are the guy that I hate, and I'm not sorry about it.

Camping has always been a controversial tactic in CoD games. The idea that someone would sit in a corner, often with a high-powered sniper like the DSR 50 in CoD: Black Ops or the M40A3 in CoD4: Modern Warfare , and pick targets off one by one always seemed counterintuitive to the fast-paced nature of CoD games. Sure, it provides better accuracy, but camping eliminates the skill involved with gunplay and instead produces boring matches as campers wait around for enemies to shoot.

Modern Warfare 4 doesn't officially launch until October 23, and the official subreddit is already full of people decrying campers . That's not everyone's experience, of course, but it appears that, since the beta, CoD players are running into lobbies filled with campers --and honestly, I'd be so pissed.

Anyway, I won't spoil how Aitch and Haaland's match goes, but it is an entertaining watch. There's plenty of screaming, camping, and screen peeking, so it's certainly worth the watch--if only for Haaland and his hot buzz cut.

Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 lands on Nintendo Switch 2, PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S on October 23. However, it's been out since October 16 if you preordered the Standard or Vault Editions.

items.title: 魔兽世界：永远为标志性经典注入新生命
items.titleEn: World of Warcraft: Forever Breathes New Life Into an Iconic Classic

content.v: 《魔兽世界》于 20 多年前首次推出，成为 MMORPG 类型的王者，并将艾泽拉斯确立为游戏中最具标志性的世界之一。现在，暴雪娱乐正在通过《魔兽世界：永远》重新构想这个世界，该游戏将于 11 月 4 日推出，在原作的基础上添加了大量新内容。
OG 游戏的感觉被延续到了《魔兽世界：永远》中，原始的角色模型和法术动画仍然完好无损。 60 级上限也回来了，升级速度变慢，让每次升级都感觉像是一种成就。但细节得到了增强，改进了核心系统、物品、用户界面和世界图形。
最重要的新增内容包括新区域、新的可玩种族和一系列新任务。我们不会因为过多介绍新地点的细节而破坏探索的感觉，但我们可以分享的是，即使是长期玩家熟悉的地区也会有一些新的惊喜。有超过 1,000 个新任务，它们将带您前往以前从未访问过的地图角落。
我们要提到的主要新区域是泽弗拉斯岛，这是一个起始区域，在保护它的空气精灵消失后陷入了危机，并且目前的人们对于下一步该做什么存在分歧。这个区域之所以引人注目，是因为它是《魔兽世界：永远》的全新可玩种族精灵 Skyborne 的所在地。
他们可以是部落或联盟的一部分，他们的种族能力由他们的阵营决定。部落成员可以进入萨满职业，联盟成员可以进入法师职业。来自任一派系的 Skyborne 都可以是战士、猎人、盗贼或德鲁伊，并且还有 Skyborne 角色独有的全新德鲁伊形态。
现有的比赛也可以参加他们以前从未参加过的课程。现在可以创建矮人萨满、不死圣骑士、人类猎人、侏儒牧师、巨魔术士和兽人法师。得益于遗留系统，我们鼓励您尝试更多此类课程，这是一个新的帐户范围内的进度系统，可为升级替代品提供好处。
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/16/wowcam006-announce-key-art-horde-eastern-kingdoms-ch-20260819-1792193187971.png
该系统引入了遗产积分，您可以通过完成遗产挑战来获得这些积分。挑战包括达到某个类别或行业技能的等级阈值、在 PvP 中获得排名、探索世界地图、完成地下城组等等。您可以作为多个替代品来完成这些挑战，并且遗产点将在您的所有角色之间共享。
然后，您可以使用遗产积分来升级三种类型的天赋树：专业、冒险和足智多谋。可用的升级多种多样，包括提高收集时找到稀有材料的几率、从击杀中恢复生命值和法力，以及消除职业能力的试剂要求等。
这些升级是针对特定角色的，因此您可以分别为每个替代品花费积分，并让它们专注于不同的事情。每个角色最多可以获得 29 点遗产点，但最多只能花费 16 点，因此该系统不需要替代点。您仍然可以仅在一个角色上使用它，但共享点池鼓励使用多个角色。
我们只是触及了所添加的所有内容的表面。有新的地下城、10 名和 20 名玩家的突袭、技能和天赋、职业内容、声誉等等。老实说，内容太多了，我们不可能在这里一一列出。还有更多内容即将推出，暴雪承诺在未来几年内将定期进行内容更新和补丁。
这些更新也不仅仅适用于残局内容。该计划是在各个级别上发布新的区域、地下城、故事情节和其他内容。因此，升级一些替代品还有另一个原因：你会看到以前没有的新地方和东西。
除了所有新增内容之外，《魔兽世界：永远》还进行了大量视觉升级。灯光、水和其他效果的更新明显改善了世界的外观，同时仍然保留了原来的艺术风格。其中包括新的全局照明、体积雾和太阳光线、捕捉光线的流水、地形投射的阴影，以及随着世界日的进展而发生的更明显的照明变化。
所有这些更新和添加都清楚地表明，暴雪将《魔兽世界：永远》视为该系列的第三大支柱，仅次于该游戏的现代版和经典版。这不仅仅是对之前内容的重述，而是一次更新，它保持了原始游戏的精神完好无损，同时寻找新的方法来更新和扩展它。
您不需要单独订阅《魔兽世界：永远》，您可以通过基础游戏或游戏时间的订阅来玩它。它将于 11 月 4 日在全球推出，现在即可预购，准备好在艾泽拉斯创造您自己的故事吧。
为了庆祝该游戏的推出，暴雪将在加拿大安大略省多伦多举办一场现实生活中的逃脱游戏竞赛。 《魔兽世界：永远》推出的《Escape Together》将汇集来自部落和联盟的一些深受粉丝喜爱的主播和角色扮演者，在面临最终考验之前，他们将在一系列的正面挑战中一决胜负：一间受标志性血色修道院启发的密室逃脱游戏。
该体验将于太平洋夏令时间 10 月 23 日星期五上午 10 点在魔兽争霸 Twitch 官方频道上直播。观众可以收看哪个派系赢得胜利。

content.v: El Psy Kongroo.

Want to know why life in a world without time travel is such a bummer? No matter when you decide to take the plunge or how many other games you play, you can only ever experience Steins;Gate for the first time once.

Even more than 15 years on from its debut, it is no exaggeration to call 5pb and Nitroplus’ quirky little character drama on the intricacies of time travel a touchstone of visual novels as a medium, and the bar by which many of its ilk continue to be measured. It is conceptually fascinating, hilarious, tragic, existentially horrifying, heartwarming, thrilling, and everything in between. It is a story where an anime catgirl at a maid café ponders whether it’s God or us who observe the flow of time, and it has my endless gratitude for that.

items.title: 《质量效应 5》预告片在网上曝光，标题为“质量效应：宇宙”，揭示了回归角色等更多内容
items.summary: A trailer for Mass Effect 5 meant for internal purposes at BioWare has leaked online, offering a glimpse at wh

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2024/11/12/mass-effect-tv-characters-thumb-1731372317002.jpg
A trailer for Mass Effect 5 meant for internal purposes at BioWare has leaked online, offering a glimpse at what might have been.

The trailer, which IGN has verified as legitimate, was created for internal purposes only and was not meant for the public. It appeared on Reddit just a day after EA's shock cancelation of the game and its developer, BioWare . It includes the title 'Mass Effect: Universe.'
The trailer begins with a message: "The following is in-engine footage from our small team. It uses our pre-production assets.”

The trailer has a number of familiar elements, including weaponry, powers, and alien species we've seen in previous Mass Effect games. There's a glimpse at a sex scene, a Mass Effect relay, space travel, and a nightclub, all Mass Effect staples. There's even a galaxy map on display inside your ship.

It looks like players would have assumed the role of a former military operative now in a "new line of work." The job is to stop fires before they start. An older Liara T'Soni appears, helping the player character out in a bar fight.

BioWare had spent the past half a decade teasing the next Mass Effect's setting and story. We'd had it confirmed that Mass Effect 5 would have been set hundreds of years after Mass Effect 3 , and feature a narrative that re-centers the action on the franchise's original Milky Way setting, long after the Reapers were defeated.

Since yesterday’s dramatic news, a number of people who had worked on Mass Effect 5 talked in vague terms about the game it was shaping up to be . On X / Twitter, New York Times bestselling author Catherynne M. Valente responded to a user who said, “A game industry that cannot figure out how to make a sequel to the literal best game of all time is a game industry that is fundamentally broken,” with: “We did figure it out. We were working on a great game. Just saying.”

One person who was laid off from BioWare, cinematic supervisor Tony de Waal, took to LinkedIn to say Mass Effect 5 would have been “something special,” offering players “a level of autonomy and choice that no other game has been able to match.”

“We saw what Larian and CD Projekt were bringing to the table with their latest offerings, and started down a path to bring Mass Effect to the next level while remaining true to the Trilogy,” he continued.

“I'm sad you won't ever get to see what we were cooking, and sad for the small, talented group of devs who were all punching above their weight to make something special. Please consider those who stayed with BioWare until the very end. They are truly some of the most talented people I've had the pleasure of working with throughout my career.”

Earlier today, IGN reported that a Mass Effect 5 trailer was ready to go before EA canceled the game and shut BioWare down. This was first mentioned in a post on the subreddit for Austin , Texas, where BioWare had a studio. An alleged EA worker spoke of “a trailer ready for Mass Effect 5 that I saw a few months ago, so I’m puzzled as to how ‘early’ they were.”

This is in reference to EA’s solitary paragraph on BioWare’s closure and the cancelation of Mass Effect 5 in the memo Cam Weber, president and chief studios officer, and David Tinson, president and COO, sent to staff on Wednesday:

“As we focus on these larger opportunities, we've had a small team at BioWare working on early-development for Mass Effect. We've made the decision not to move forward with this development, which means we’re closing the studio and our Edmonton workspace. BioWare is a legendary studio that helped define the role-playing genre, and we do not take this decision lightly.”

The mention of the next Mass Effect being in “early development” shocked some fans, given the game was announced at The Game Awards in December 2020. At the time, BioWare said the project was in “early production.”

According to Bloomberg , BioWare had around 50 staff working on Mass Effect 5 when EA closed the studio, which comes after 2024’s launch of Dragon Age: The Veilguard failed to meet EA’s sales expectations. 400 jobs will reportedly go in total across EA, amounting to 3% of total staff.
BioWare’s Austin studio reportedly remains open, working to support various EA games in development. IGN has asked EA for comment.

The end of Mass Effect and BioWare comes just weeks before the annual N7 Day, set for November 7. Less than 12 months ago, Mike Gamble, executive producer of Mass Effect at BioWare, celebrated N7 Day to say the next Mass Effect game was still in development, to express excitement about the Amazon TV series ( which IGN understands is currently still in the works ), and to insist EA and BioWare "remain committed to telling more stories in this universe."

Fans had hoped to see more of Mass Effect 5 on N7 Day next month, but it now seems likely to pass without fanfare. “You made me laugh. Thank you,” Gamble replied to one X / Twitter user who wondered what might be announced on N7 Day next month.

We have much more on the dramatic news of BioWare's closure, including reaction from fans and the video game industry , IGN's Ryan McCaffrey on why BioWare was the greatest RPG developer ever , and the thoughts of one former BioWare developer on the possibility of Dragon Age and Mass Effect living on .

items.title: 我以前从未见过带有漫画的笔记本电脑冷却器，但它仍然无法让我相信这个吵闹的野兽值 50 美元
items.summary: Not so cool.

content.v: https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/MopksAbEqHgsjRp86WSqTg-1920-80.jpg

I find myself charmed (and perhaps a little perturbed) by the little black envelope included with this Klim Everest laptop cooling pad. Inside you get a set of shiny stickers, a warranty card, and, err.. a comic strip depicting the fictional process that begins when you order one.

"Your product was carefully retrieved from our inventory with sterilized anti-bacterial gloves and placed on a satin silk cushion," the first panel explains. "The party we organized to celebrate your order lasted three days."

Okay, that's something I've never seen before. And I'll be honest, the sarcastic comic endears me to the product more than it should. I could do without the last panel, though, which says: "If you feel like it, send us a photo of you (or your pet) and we'll send you a printable version of this comic strip with your photo on it."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/V6EzDDicevtbN3qJbwAPpm-1920-80.jpg

A step too far, I feel. Anyway, the pad itself is a very sizable unit, designed to cool laptops from 14 to 17.3-inches in size and powered by a USB Type-A port. Atop its silver plastic frame sits a foam gasket, designed to create a seal between the bottom of your lappy and the outside air. Two 60 mm fans pull cool air from the rear of the pad and fire it at the bottom of your machine, into any awaiting vents.

The full MSRP of the Klim Everest is listed as $60, but it's currently down to $50 at Amazon . There are cheaper options on the market, but this one is much more wallet-friendly than, say, this Razer unit for a mahoosive $150 .

Speaking of which, I have an ageing Razer Blade 15 that likes to get toasty under full load. So, I booted up the Cyberpunk 2077 benchmark, ran it on repeat, and gathered my temperature readings—before placing the lappy atop the Everest (making sure not to block any vents) to see if it made much difference.
