(MHz) The Klin Everest does manage to lower the peak CPU temperature of the Blade 15 by two degrees, resulting in ever-so-slightly higher clockspeeds. However, gaming performance and GPU stats remain well within margins of error. In terms of noise? Yes, very much so. The Everest makes an irritating whirring sound whenever it moves a meaningful amount of air, and the extra cooling doesn't convince the Blade 15's fans to shut up under heavy load, either. The two combine together to create quite the racket, particularly at higher settings.

And in terms of temps? The Blade 15's RTX 3080 mobile still jumps to the same thermal peak, even with the cooler set to maximum, although I did record a single degree difference in the average GPU temps. However, the clockspeed and performance figures remain well within margins of error. In fact, the average GPU frequency is slightly higher without the pad, as are the 1% lows. Excellent.
The bargain-basement screen is rubbish, as is the RGB lighting—and quite a few user reviews note reliability issues

That being said, it did manage to drop the peak CPU temperature by a whole two degrees, which seems to have resulted in ever-so-slightly higher clockspeeds. Not that it made any difference to actual gaming performance, but hey. A tiny win's still a win.

What my editor has sent me, then, is a large and noisy plinth to rest my laptop on—and little else. The Everest would likely make more of a difference when used with badly overheating machines, perhaps within hotter ambient temperatures, but it certainly hasn't made any major improvements to my gaming laptop on a sunny October day.

I think a simple laptop stand, enough to raise your machine off a desk to free up airflow beneath the bottom vents, would be a more cost-effective buy. I've found a decent-looking one for $18 . It doesn't come with a comic, though. Shame.

So, is the Klim Everest a "Recycle Bin" candidate? Well, it's loud, largely ineffectual, still pricier than you might expect, and quite the desk dominator. Oh, and the bargain-basement screen is rubbish, as is the RGB lighting—and quite a few user reviews note reliability issues.
Ah, screw it. Put it in the bin and be done with it.

What I got...
Klim Everest laptop cooling pad Large, noisy, and if you ask me, still overpriced. It did manage to drop my laptop's CPU temps by a very small amount, but I still don't think this is worth $50.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/oukas3kZL5UwK3Wdh9id2U.jpg
What I'd recommend...

Any bottomless laptop stand This one's a mere $18, and looks perfectly acceptable. Anything that raises your laptop vents off your desk is likely to help with cooling—and at this price, I'd say it's worth a go.

items.title: “因为这款游戏，我们可能卖出了数百万块主板，这真是太棒了”：3dfx 联合创始人给予 Quake “我们整体成功的巨大荣誉”
items.summary: It's now been 30 years since the first Voodoo card.

content.v: If you care about retro PC gaming hardware, there's a good chance you've heard of the now-defunct 3dfx. And if you know 3dfx, there's an even better chance you've heard of the 3dfx Voodoo graphics card. Well, according to one of its founders, its success is owed at least in part to the legendary shooter Quake.
Ross Smith recently spoke to our friends at Club386 in celebration of the first 3dfx Voodoo turning 30 years old, and he talks about the 'Quake effect'.

Effectively, though Quake launched in June 1996, it didn't get GLQuake, which allowed for 3D hardware acceleration, until the start of 1997. John Carmack reportedly reached out to 3dfx, which then worked on an API called MiniGL that could run the game. In its implementation, 3dfx cards could then run the game at a better resolution in greater detail with a wider range of colours.

Smith says, "I would certainly give id, John, and Quake a great deal of credit for our overall success—we probably sold millions of boards because of that game, and it was magnificent. That’s the last game I’ve gone all the way to the end on, and I was exhausted after doing that. It was well crafted, beautiful, dark."

It makes sense why developers would want to work with the likes of 3dfx because better compatibility makes their games look better. And a developer is more likely to sell a game if it can wow an audience.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/nRu3QczRKLYEtDPut6ra5B-1920-80.jpg
This symbiotic relationship was key to 3dfx development at the start. 3dfx reportedly reached out to developers to show games pre-rendered on 3dfx Voodoo cards, and "they loved it".

Smith argues this relationship to developers was quite unique at the time. "Most other companies, like S3 or others, saw game developers kind of as a necessary evil, not as the lifeblood of a company that’s focused on gaming. So we flipped the whole thing around.”

This is a relationship that might seem familiar nowadays, with the likes of Nvidia, Intel, and AMD working directly with developers to improve software. Nvidia and 3dfx famously took each other to court for various patent infringement complaints in the late '90s and early '00s, and Nvidia acquired many of 3dfx's assets after it filed for bankruptcy in the early 2000s. So in a way, we have 3dfx to thank for parts of Nvidia's successes in the following years, too.

And 3dfx was unique in a few ways. The Voodoo cards had great 3D acceleration because it was designed specifically for 3D acceleration as a co-processor alongside a 2D card, letting the CPU do other background work at the same time.

It was just one of many steps towards hardware that was specifically designed for gaming rigs. "We did something revolutionary there," says Smith, "we didn’t have a VGA. That was partly down to our lack of design experience, and partly down to my concern about profitability and compatibility. Being compatible with a million apps is really hard—being compatible with 200 games is much easier.”

Alan Wake 2: Deluxe Edition (PS5) Drops to the Lowest Price Ever

Alan Wake 2 was released almost exactly three years ago, on October 27, 2023. In addition to Tristan Ogilvie's glowing Alan Wake 2 IGN review , the game also ranked as our best horror game of 2023 . Alan Wake 2 mixes survival horror 3rd-person action gameplay with immersive live action cutscenes with really high production values. There are very few games quite like it. I generally don't have the stomach for horror games and, sadly, this game was too scary for me to completely finish.

items.title: Dispatch 推出超过 16 小时的新内容，包括评论曲目、移动版本和现场音乐会，庆祝成立一周年
items.summary: Dispatch is now officially one year old! To celebrate, Adhoc is giving fans oodles of new content in the form

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/07/28/dispatchthumb-1785269662531.png

Dispatch is now officially one year old! To celebrate, AdHoc Studio is giving fans oodles of new content in the form of a commentary track and storyboard modes, a new mobile version of the game, a live concert with a performance from Prism herself, and yes, more merch.

AdHoc’s debut title, Dispatch , released to rave reviews on October 22, 2025. Made up of Telltale alumni, the devs truly flexed their storytelling chops with this game, bringing players along for Robert’s journey from zero to hero alongside a chaotic cast of lovable, super-powered characters.

A year later, fans are anxiously awaiting more updates on AdHoc’s next project — but in the meantime, they can whet their appetites on some exciting additions to Dispatch and fun experiences that bring the game's digital world to reality.

Now included in Dispatch's Deluxe Edition are a Commentary Mode and Storyboard Mode. Commentary Mode brings players back to the days of DVD Special Features with two separate audio tracks, where the game’s actors and developers chat about the project in the background as the game progresses. Each choice will give you new insights into the game, so there’s even more replayability for curious fans who want all the gritty details about how Dispatch was made. Storyboard mode shows players the sketches that laid out how the game's scenes were planned, and it can even be paired with Commentary Mode for a double-whammy.

The Deluxe Edition also comes with a digital art book and four digital comics. What’s more, those who already own the Deluxe Edition will get the Commentary and Storyboard modes for free, while those who have the standard version of the game can upgrade for $10.99 USD.

But wait, there’s more! Dispatch is also coming to mobile, letting you join Rob on his adventures wherever you’re at in the world. The game releases on Android and iOS on December 9, 2026, with additional support for Google Play Games on PC. The base game has been rebuilt for touch screens and vertical play, and mobile players can get the first four episodes for free. The full release will cost $19.99, with pre-orders opening on the Google Play store and Apple store soon.

Fans have been begging for more merchandise in the months since Dispatch first came to Steam, and now, they finally get their wish. A three-record soundtrack vinyl set, featuring artwork from Dispatch’s art director, Derek Stratton, will be available to purchase, and 100 of those will be signed by him. Shirts, hoodies, and four physical comics are also available for purchase, with each volume boasting an individual cover that creates an epic battle scene when placed side by side. A Dispatch: Design Works hardcover book and collectible box are also up for sale, going behind the scenes with concept art, cast interviews, developer insights, and more. And for the real collectors out there, the first 1,000 orders placed on the official online store will get a never-before-seen limited edition, numbered collector’s card.

Perhaps most excitingly, the music of Dispatch is getting brought to life with a special concert for one night only. On Thursday, December 3, fans can gather at the AVALON Hollywood to watch ‘Hoes Depressed’ singer and the voice of Prism, THOT SQUAD, perform songs from the game live alongside Bershy, Primer, Caroline Kingsbury, and Fartbarf. Tickets for this event are extremely limited, with AdHoc Studio email subscribers getting first pick before they open up to the general public. It's an in-person event only, so it won't be streamed, and you'll want to get your tickets fast.

"Dispatch was only possible because of folks who believed in it enough to show up and do their best work. In our industry, it's often really hard to showcase those people and how the development process actually works, but fortunately our game is very weird and specific and affords us some unique opportunities." said Nick Herman, Co-Creative Director on Dispatch and COO of AdHoc Studio.

"So for the fans who made Dispatch a part of their lives, we wanted to give them more ways to experience the world they love, whether that’s playing alongside the cast and crew, experiencing the entire game in its original storyboards, or hanging out together IRL at the wildest version of a Dispatch concert our finance team would sign off on."

If you haven't gotten to play Dispatch yet, now is the time. IGN scored the game a glowing 9 out of 10 , with reviewer Sara Thwaites calling it a "sharp-witted workplace comedy that charms with its smart dialogue choices, great writing, and lovably aggravating cast."

items.title: 《Dispatch》将于 12 月登陆移动平台，前四集免费
items.summary: Ahead of its first anniversary, Dispatch developer AdHoc has revealed a big (and free) update for the deluxe e

content.v: Ahead of its first anniversary, Dispatch developer AdHoc has revealed a big (and free) update for the deluxe edition of the superhero workplace-dramedy. Available now on all platforms where the deluxe edition is available, two new behind-the-scenes modes are being added to Dispatch. Dispatch is also getting a mobile release for Android and iOS, a live concert in Los Angeles, and more.

The first one, Commentary, adds over 16 hours of cast and crew commentary across two tracks. Different choices made in the game will unlock different commentary, and the cast commentary track features Aaron Paul, Laura Bailey, Erin Yvette, and more of the cast. Storyboard will give players the ability to experience the entire game through the original storyboard animatics. This mode will show how the game was developed, with a closer look at how AdHoc developed the scenes, performances, and visual storytelling behind Dispatch. You can even double up on modes and enable the commentary tracks over Storyboard mode.

"Dispatch was only possible because of folks who believed in it enough to show up and do their best work. In our industry, it's often really hard to showcase those people and how the development process actually works, but fortunately our game is very weird and specific and affords us some unique opportunities," said Nick Herman, Co-Creative Director on Dispatch and COO of AdHoc Studio, in a press release. "So for the fans who made Dispatch a part of their lives, we wanted to give them more ways to experience the world they love, whether that’s playing alongside the cast and crew, experiencing the entire game in its original storyboards, or hanging out together IRL at the wildest version of a Dispatch concert our finance team would sign off on."

The mobile edition of Dispatch will be available starting December 9, and AdHoc says it has been rebuilt for touch and vertical play. The first four episodes will be available for free at launch, and the full edition of the game will cost $20. Beyond that, AdHoc will also release new anniversary merchandise alongside the upcoming vinyl soundtrack , the digital comics are getting a physical edition release, and a new hardcover book from Lost in Cult, Dispatch: Design Works collection, will explore the making of Dispatch.

To cap things off, a Dispatch concert will be held for one night only, on December 3 at Avalon Hollywood in Los Angeles. One of last year’s biggest hit games --Dispatch follows Robert Robertson III, formerly the superhero Mecha Man. With his suit trashed and funds low, Robertson takes on a new job at the Superhero Dispatch Network (SDN) as a dispatcher, directing the superhuman resources at his disposal to fight crime and save the day.

content.v: 卡普空于日前发布公告，确认旗下 Capcom ID 服务发生重大数据泄露，涉及全球超过1170万个账户。卡普空表示，公司已采取紧急措施并阻断未经授权的访问，目前正在全面调查事件影响。
https://image.gcores.com/3e5b951120bb34da47377fcc0149e74e-1280-720.webp
据悉，本次事件共泄露11,774,247个电子邮箱地址及相关的账户信息，包括账号创建时间、最后登录时间、登录次数以及最近一次登录的IP地址。其中有43个账户受影响更深，泄露了出生日期、性别、国家或地区以及昵称。
值得注意的是，本次数据泄露还导致196个账户的密码被未经授权修改。卡普空已重置这些账户的密码，并强调没有发现玩家原始设置的密码泄露，信用卡等支付信息也不在受影响数据范围内。
卡普空指出，公司10月19日首次发现未经授权访问的迹象，随即在调查的同时封堵异常活动。10月20日，卡普空成立内部特别工作组，并于10月21日向警方及日本个人信息保护委员会报案。
目前卡普空正在联系受影响用户，提醒大家注意可疑邮件。由于数百万电子邮箱暴露，攻击者可能会冒充卡普空或相关公司发起钓鱼攻击。

items.title: Steam Next Fest 精选 3 款与 indie.io 截然不同的生存游戏
items.titleEn: 3 Very Different Survival Games from indie.io Featured in Steam Next Fest

content.v: 十月是深入研究生存游戏的最佳时机，从即日起至 10 月 26 日，来自发行平台 indie.io 的三款游戏将成为 Steam Next Fest 的一部分。这三款游戏证明了“生存游戏”可以意味着非常不同的事物，并且具有完全不同的游戏玩法。
一部是以煤矿为背景的合作恐怖喜剧，一部是僵尸末日后的开放世界沙盒，一部是在你的船神秘坠毁后，你独自被困在一个由 24 个岛屿组成的群岛上。您现在就可以玩所有三款游戏，其中两款在 Steam Next Fest 中提供免费演示，一款已经完全发布，并针对恐怖季节进行了巨大的新内容更新。
煤炭税
三代之前，天空结冰了。现在，你的煤矿小镇永远被雪覆盖。您可能认为这将是矿井的终结，但事实并非如此，该州一直保持矿井开放，并迫使矿工继续深入矿井深处。这听起来可能有点反乌托邦，但这是煤炭税挖掘幽默和煤炭的前提。
这是一款适合 1 至 5 名玩家的合作开采游戏，您扮演一群矿工，必须克服矿井中的重重危险，才能生存并带着收集到的材料离开。每次运行通常都是按程序进行的，因此您需要与队友一起努力找出如何取得进展。
这种团队合作依赖于 Coal Duty 最有趣的机制之一：近距离语音聊天。你们可以互相交谈，但您的队友只有在附近才能听到您的声音。您可以打电话让他们知道您找到了正确的路线，警告他们有危险，或者您认为值得一提的任何其他事情。但要小心：如果矿井里的其他东西足够近的话，它们也能听到你的声音，而且你不想因为你太健谈而引发任何危险。
这些危险是多种多样的。有几十种不同的生物，每种生物都有你需要弄清楚的特征，才能学习如何有效地对付它们。有些是盲目的，有些是快速的，有些会将自己伪装成煤炭。没有什么比听到你的朋友突然惊慌失措更好的了，因为敌人吓到了他们，而他们的尖叫声却引起了更多不必要的注意。
现在可以在 Steam Next Fest 期间免费试玩《Coal Duty》，现在是您和您的朋友尝试的好时机。它于 10 月 27 日（即 Next Fest 结束后的第二天）以抢先体验形式发布。演示版是游戏特意的一部分，而抢先体验版本将添加更多的矿井层、生物和逃生机器。
人文Z
IGN 报道了 HumanitZ 在 2 月份发布的 1.0，这款等距开放世界僵尸生存沙盒游戏刚刚发布了自 10 月 19 日以来的最大更新。它引入了一些主要的新内容：NPC 招募、玩家僵尸化、万圣节活动、仅限爆头模式、新装备等等。
完成无线电塔任务后，您现在就可以招募您在世界上遇到的 NPC 幸存者。他们可以跟随你奔跑、在你的基地工作、站岗或被派去执行任务。你可以建造两个额外的前哨站，并根据你的需要在它们之间派遣你的新兵，每个 NPC 都有自己的特点。
您还需要真正关注这些特征。有些只有在 NPC 进入您的社区一段时间后才会变得清晰，他们可能会透露他们并不像您想象的那么友好。 NPC 招募功能可在单人游戏和托管多人游戏模式中使用，因为服务器上的游戏有其他玩家来填补这个角色。
在更新中，如果你死于怪人（HumanitZ 僵尸的名字）或感染，你的角色将成为怪人本身。极客版本的你将带着你所有的战利品在世界上徘徊，但你可以追踪他们并杀死他们并拿回战利品。
万圣节更新添加了主题化妆品、任务、武器和世界道具。仅限爆头模式，顾名思义：只有当你向怪人的头部开枪时，他们才会死亡，这会提高难度。更新的新装备包括杠杆式步枪、射钉枪、雨披、巴拉克拉法帽和可抢劫的大型工具箱。
如果您之前玩过 HumanitZ，那么这次更新就足够重要了，值得您再回来玩一遍。如果您还没有，这是您尝试一下的邀请。目前，它在 Steam 上的评级为“大多数正面”，有超过 4,400 条评论。
五月天：生存岛
IGN 首次报道了《五月天：生存岛》的演示版，当时它于 8 月和 9 月初在 gamescom 和 PAX West 上亮相。此后，该演示版发生了重大变化，但仍然可以在 Steam 上免费试用。
更新后的演示包括大量的错误修复和改进，使其与完整版本中的游戏玩法保持一致。它还扩展了房屋建筑系统并引入了大量新内容。您在演示版中的保存数据可以延续到 11 月 2 日发布的完整版本中，因此这本质上就像抢占了先机。
游戏的基本前提是，你的船失事了，你被冲到一个神秘的岛屿上，你发现它是组成一个巨大群岛的 24 个岛屿之一。每个岛屿都是由 Pequi Studios 的小型开发团队手工制作的，它们不是程序生成的。他们都有不同的环境、要收集的材料和要寻找的宝藏。
你需要使用这些材料来制造工具，然后可以用来打猎、捕鱼、种植农作物，并最终为自己建造一个家园。基本上，你需要做的就是生存所需的一切。你可以花任意多的时间在每个岛屿上建立你的基地，而何时前往下一个岛屿则由你决定。随着你的进步，你将揭开群岛的秘密，是什么把你带到这里，并查明是否有可能回家。
